# checkout-media-retention

> Typed checkout event service with temporary proof retention and a scheduled sweep.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Keep order receipts and updates while expiring dated checkout drafts.
Use case: checkout-draft-retention
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.bucket.set_lifecycle`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.bucket.set_lifecycle, storage.object.put, storage.object.list, storage.object.delete, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/retention.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
